LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 3.3.1 WORD CLASSES: PRIMARY AUXILIARIES

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.3: Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Word Classes: Primary Auxiliaries

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Word Classes: Primary Auxiliaries. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What are the functions of verbs in sentences?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify primary auxiliary verbs in a text
2. use primary auxiliary verbs in sentences correctly
3. appreciate the importance of primary auxiliary verbs in communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 3.3.1 WORD CLASSES: PRIMARY AUXILIARIES
This lesson teaches Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Word Classes: Primary Auxiliaries for Grade 8 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify primary auxiliary verbs in a text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use primary auxiliary verbs in sentences correctly
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the importance of primary auxiliary verbs in communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Word Classes: Primary Auxiliaries using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Word Classes: Primary Auxiliaries above.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Word Classes: Primary Auxiliaries to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Word Classes: Primary Auxiliaries.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Word Classes: Primary Auxiliaries with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Word Classes: Primary Auxiliaries important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

SECTION: REMEMBER

2. use primary auxiliary verbs in sentences correctly
